description: Defines the DoorBell class and its nested Connector class, implementing doorbell signaling with socket communication and event handling.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell mechanism with signaling, waiting, and acknowledgment functionalities.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles socket-based resource binding, unbinding, and ring signaling for the DoorBell.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ring
methods.description: Triggers the doorbell signal and sets the event.

methods.name: DoorBell::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell event with a specified timeout.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ringing
methods.description: Sets the internal signal event indicating ringing.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Ring
methods.description: Sends a ring signal via socket.
